title: Hub snapshots plugins before post-update dependencies exist
original_report: email-cli 0.3.1 help fails from the Codex cache with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @napi-rs/keyring although the Hub installation succeeded and post-update installed dependencies in the managed marketplace copy.
discovery_scope: email-cli post-update hook and skill entrypoint
expected: The post-update hook finishes preparing the managed plugin before Codex snapshots that plugin into its executable cache; email-cli help returns one JSON object with exit code 0.
actual: Hub registered the plugin with Codex before running post-update, so the managed copy gained node_modules after the cache snapshot and the cached entrypoint could not import @napi-rs/keyring.
reproduction: A focused regression extracts the real install function and requires post-update to precede marketplace registration and plugin add. The unmodified 0.4.33 order fails. A temporary email-cli managed copy then runs its real post-update hook, is copied as the cache snapshot, and its real help entrypoint returns JSON with exit 0.
failure_signal: The focused install-order assertion fails on 0.4.33 because runPostUpdateHook appears after codex plugin add.
root_cause: Hobbyka Hub called codex plugin add before runPostUpdateHook, while Codex snapshots the local plugin at add time.
fix_summary: Moved the existing copy-updater and post-update preparation before configureMarketplace and codex plugin add; no email-cli-specific fallback was added.
why_causal: Every generated runtime dependency now exists in the managed plugin before the single cache snapshot that must contain it.

reproduction_files.summary: Regression contract for post-update before cache snapshot.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: Same command changed from exit 1 to exit 0.

checks.name: Real email-cli cache fixture
checks.detail: @napi-rs/keyring existed in the cache copy and help returned one JSON object with exit 0.

limitations: The real cache fixture was verified on macOS; Windows packaging remains covered by the existing Hub regression suite.
residual_risks: A future post-update hook that requires its own target plugin to already be registered would need an explicit separate contract. No current shipped hook has that dependency.
notes: The dirty standalone /Users/ardanila/code/email-cli checkout was not modified.
The fix applies to every Hub plugin with generated runtime artifacts, not only email-cli.
